verdicts.summary: The only hazard is the hand-kept driver list, already stated in finding 0.
A failed secretStore.set leaves the plaintext in the file and is retried. Only successful moves are redacted.
verdicts.scenario: secretStore.set fails for one secret while others succeed. Only names in `moved` are rewritten to the marker, so the failed value stays usable and is retried next load.

verdicts.summary: The marker round-trips as 'keep'. Redaction covers provider config through the same walk.
verdicts.scenario: A client sends back config containing the marker for a saved apiKey. In persist, `redacted` is true, so `value` comes from the previous inline value or is undefined, and the secret is kept (not removed) under the same name.

verdicts.summary: A saved secret on a settings-variant provider form cannot be cleared from the UI.
verdicts.scenario: 1) A user has a saved Antigravity apiKey, so the client sees the marker. 2) The settings variant renders SecretInput with value="" and configured=true. 3) The user focuses the input and clears it. The draft is still "" and equals value, so useCommitOnBlur never fires. Even if it fired, SecretInput drops an empty commit. 4) There is no clear control in ProviderSettingsForm. The key stays until the user deletes the instance. Before this commit the apiKey was a plain input and could be emptied.
verdicts.consequence: Users cannot remove a stored provider API key from the UI. The SecretInput comment says clearing 'belongs to its form', but this form has no clear action.

verdicts.summary: The annotation lookup and the shared field list work for the orderings used.
verdicts.scenario: I checked whether a field would silently drop the flag. `secretSettingsFields` and `isSecretSetting` read the key annotation first and fall back to the schema annotation. Server maps are built from the same function the web uses.

verdicts.summary: The host field list now comes from `secretSettingsFields`, and host secret names are unchanged.
verdicts.scenario: I checked whether host secret names or fields changed. Names still come from sourceControlHostSecretName, and fields come from the definition's settings schema.
